_stamp: [2026-10-27 06:00 PM Johnny Chu - Chu Hoàng Anh] PHASE-0.143 S143-L2 (D143-1) — GraphRAG evidence of ONE notebook as data. Site MCP tool brain.graph_ask (code: BizCity_TwinBrain_Graph_Ask in core/twinbrain). NO LLM. The cell composes, gates tokens against source_map, emits kg_highlight from entity_ids of the tokens it used. Runtime JSON; docs/ is never read at runtime.

source_ids.note: narrows passages to these sources; empty = all

guru_id.note: > 0 = a Guru turn: the notebook must be in the Guru's folder scope, else mode empty (R-SCOPE-FOLDER, fails closed)

data.reason: string, only when mode = empty (no_passage | guru_scope_empty)
data.source_map: [{ token '[nb:<notebook_id>/p<passage_id>]', notebook_id, passage_id, source_id (> 0), source_title, heading_path[], content (<= 1200 chars), score, score_source (rerank|graph_relation|vector|keyword), entity_ids[] }]
data.triples: [{ relation_id, head, predicate, tail, head_id, tail_id, text }] (<= 12)
data.entities: [{ id, name, type, weight }] (<= 24, entities of the used passages first)
data.stats: { seed_entities, seed_relations, expanded, reranked, took_ms, bin: ok|missing|rebuild_required }

rules: token format is exactly [nb:<notebook_id>/p<passage_id>]; the cell strips any token not in source_map
passages with source_id <= 0 (chat-promoted) are never evidence
mode empty ⇒ the cell says it did not find it; it never invents a citation
no chat() fallback in rerank (Hub /rerank or the cosine order)
